The '''Massacre of Myomar''' was an atrocity perpetrated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Ishin-Il-Raz]].<ref name="Who" /> [[Time/Legends|Sometime]] between [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Time" /> Il-Raz sought to earn favor from [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] through a series of military actions, which included the [[bombardment of Shalam]] and the attack<ref name="Who" /> against the inhabitants<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Myomar/Legends|Myomar]]<ref name="Who" /> in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Myomar system/Legends|Myomar system]]</ref> Commanding the massacre from his [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Emperor's Disciple]]'',<ref name="Who" /> Il-Raz secured an Imperial victory on Myomar,<ref name="CSWE" /> along with extensive civilian casualties.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Massacre of Myomar was first mentioned in the article "[[Who's Who: Imperial Grand Admirals]]," written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Abel G. Peña]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 66|''Star Wars Insider'' 66]]<ref name="Who" /> on [[March 4]], [[2003]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2003/02/news20030203.html|text=''Star Wars Insider'' #66}}</ref>
